summary.name: Vintage Photo Collage (category: Printmaking and Craft Materials; provenance explicit, directly described in the source).
summary.visualIdentity: Explicitly, Vintage Photo Collage combines period-consistent photographs, newspaper fragments, clipped objects and visible paper edges. Distinct grain and print characteristics are preserved within a unified palette. Layers read as cutouts that stay coherent with one theme.
summary.suitableUses: Explicitly, hybrid notes name historical documentaries, archives and history explainers as best-for uses. Inferred: archival storytelling built from real period imagery and timelines. Product, commercial or general-purpose uses are unspecified and not supported by the source.
summary.limitations: Explicitly, the style requires period photographs, and none were supplied, so missing assets must be reported rather than invented. Avoid modern UI charts, fabricated data and excess parallax. Two-color contrast checks do not prove readability over photos or textures, so recheck actual composited frames. Subject extraction and irregular paper edges need separate masks.
summary.palette: Reference-dependent optional example, applying only to new presentation elements. Background #EDE3CD is neutral paper, foreground #393329 is type with 9.806:1 contrast, and accent_1 #85765D is decorative only at 3.47:1, not for body text. Gradients are disabled; photographs keep their colors, and task-provided colors override these.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Explicit motion: cutout movement, modest parallax and object-based scene connections on a single seekable GSAP timeline. Optional references are motion-037 (clipped words rotate and disperse) and motion-038 (punctuation zoom), each only if scene assets support it. Motion-012, motion-015 and motion-018 apply only to chapters, narrative steps or a real image set with captions. Video needs no live input; PhotoSwipe interactions must be recreated as authored transforms.
summary.audio: Unspecified: no audio was supplied and no direction is fixed. Suggested options are restrained ambience, sparing sound accents on cutout movement, or voiceover, chosen from topic and audience. Inferred: keep speech intelligible and avoid competing sung vocals. Music timing applies only after actual audio analysis, since beat synchronization is not assumed.
summary.assetRequirements: Explicitly required: period-consistent photographs, newspaper fragments and clipped objects, none supplied, so the gap must be reported. Preprocess with Pillow for cropping, masks and textures, or Sharp in Node.js. Cropper.js handles rectangular framing only. Irregular paper edges and subject cutouts need authored masks, and fonts and assets must load before rendering.
summary.combinations: Explicit suggestions: style-024 for handwritten archival labels in #393329, written on after cutouts settle and never covering faces. Style-097 for paper-strip timelines with accurate dates and a neutral palette. Avoid colored notes, invented photos, overcrowding and excess parallax. Combinations are optional and need compatible materials.
summary.productionApproach: HyperFrames is the default pipeline for composition, timing, validation (npx hyperframes check), snapshots and export; Remotion is fallback only when its condition is verified and recorded. Visual layers use PixiJS or native DOM/SVG per fidelity, with GSAP as the paused motion engine. Verify opening, key-action, transition and closing frames, seeks and audio sync. Template placeholders are unresolved; no task inputs were supplied.
